mentor.consentLead: The assistant answers with an AI model in the cloud. Each question sends:
mentor.consentAgain: The list has changed since you agreed: a question now sends more of the facts the app counted, so you are asked again.
mentor.consentNotes: the notes of the selected passage: for each note its bar and hand, its place in the bar, its length, its pitch, how loud it is and where it came from: imported, detected, inferred, or confirmed or corrected by you (with Whole piece, no notes);
mentor.consentDigest: the facts the app found there, each with its id: the key, the chords, the phrases, the bars to check and the tempo of the selected bars;
mentor.consentPiece: with Whole piece, the facts the app counted in the whole piece, each with its id: its form sections and what they share, keys, summary, tempo, hand ranges, densest bars, new material, phrases and sentences as the score shows them (not who set their boundaries), chords per section, cadences and bars to check;
mentor.consentQuestion: your question and this conversation, with what the assistant looked up in the passage.
mentor.consentWhere: They go only to the Motiff Lab API, which passes them to the AI model's provider for the answer and keeps nothing of them.
mentor.consentNot: Never sent: the file and its name, the notes of the rest of the piece, your marks, notes, bookmarks and recordings.
mentor.sentNote: A question sends the passage's notes and facts to the Motiff Lab API.
mentor.interpretation: The assistant's reading · cites the app's facts
mentor.engineFacts: The app's facts · the answer could not be checked
mentor.reason.empty: Why: the AI model gave no answer.
mentor.reason.tooLong: Why: the model's answer was too long.
mentor.reason.noCitation: Why: the model's answer cited none of the app's facts.
mentor.reason.unknownFact: Why: the model's answer cited facts the app did not find.
mentor.reason.timeout: Why: the model did not answer in time.
mentor.reason.modelError: Why: the AI model's service answered with an error.
mentor.reason.toolNotAllowed: Why: the model asked for a step the assistant may not take.
mentor.reason.badArguments: Why: the model asked the app for a step with values it does not take.
mentor.reason.tooManyCalls: Why: the model asked the app for too many steps for one question.
mentor.reason.other: Why: the model's answer did not pass the app's check.
mentor.empty: Ask about the selection or the whole piece. Every answer cites the facts the app found, and each one shows its place in the score.
mentor.noConsent: Not sent: agree to what a question sends first.
mentor.notConfigured: The assistant's AI model is not switched on yet, so nothing was sent.
mentor.notAllowed: The assistant is not open to this account yet, so nothing was sent.
mentor.pro: The assistant is part of Pro, so nothing was sent.
mentor.dailyCap: That's all the questions for today; ask again tomorrow. Nothing was sent.
mentor.signIn: Sign in to ask the assistant. Nothing was sent.
mentor.tooLarge: The passage is too long for one question; select fewer bars. Nothing was sent.
mentor.tooManyBars: Select at most 32 bars, or ask about the whole piece. Nothing was sent.
mentor.refused: The assistant could not take this question. Try asking it another way.
mentor.unreachable: The assistant could not be reached. Check the connection and ask again.
assistantDraft.cardLabel: {0} with the assistant's draft above them
assistantDraft.byEngine: The assistant chose the operation; the app made the notes and wrote what changes.
assistantDraft.stale: This draft no longer fits the notes. Ask again.
padAssistant.title: Assistant
padAssistant.noConversations: No conversations about this piece yet.
padAssistant.continueHint: Opens the assistant's chat with a new conversation that starts from this question and its answer, to go on asking there.
padAssistant.cancelled: Cancelled. The notes are as they were.
padAssistant.signIn: Sign in to talk to the assistant. Nothing was sent.
padAssistant.serverError: The assistant's server answered with an error. Nothing was lost: try again.
padAssistant.lookingUp: The assistant is looking in the score…
dictation.listening: Listening… Speak; tap the microphone or pause to finish.
dictation.notOnDevice: Dictation is not available: this iPad cannot recognise English speech on the iPad itself, and the sound is never sent anywhere.
dictation.denied: Dictation needs the microphone and speech recognition: allow them for Motiff Lab in the iPad's Settings.
dictation.restricted: Dictation is not allowed by this iPad's settings.
dictation.failed: Dictation stopped before it heard anything. Tap the microphone to try again.
mentor.draftConsentTitle: Before your first question in a draft
mentor.draftConsentLead: The assistant answers with an AI model in the cloud. In a draft each question sends:
mentor.draftConsentNotes: the notes of the place's base and of the variant you build from (at most 32 bars each): for each note its bar and hand, place in the bar, length, pitch, velocity and where it came from;
mentor.draftConsentTechniques: the list of techniques (what differs, in which bars, how sure, whether taken) and the description of the place's seams (key, meter, tempo, register, bridge candidates), each fact with its id;
mentor.draftConsentQuestion: your question and this conversation with what the assistant looked at in the place.
mentor.draftConsentNot: Never sent: a recording's sound, files and their names, the piece's title, the notes of the draft's other places, your marks, notes, bookmarks and data.
mentor.placeTooLong: The place or its variant is longer than 32 bars, more than a question in a draft takes. Nothing was sent.
mentor.placeTooLarge: The place and its variant are too dense for one question. Nothing was sent.
mentor.placeUnread: The draft's place could not be read. Nothing was sent.
